What is the blockchain economy: The blockchain economy is an ecosystem where value, assets, and data are digitized, transferred, and traded transparently on-chain. It enables new business models built on decentralization, transparency, and global connectivity.
Which types of businesses should join?: Enterprises with strong customer engagement and large value flows—such as banking & finance, tourism, retail, FMCG, e-commerce, and banking & finance—will benefit the most from joining the blockchain economy.
What stage is Vietnam in: Vietnam is in the phase of piloting and developing a regulatory framework for digital assets and blockchain services. This is the “early adoption” stage, where early movers can capture competitive advantages and expand their market influence in the region.
Challenges for businesses?: Businesses face incomplete regulatory frameworks, limited expertise, difficulties in technology integration, and challenges in convincing customers to adopt new blockchain-based products.
What NEX3 solves?: NEX3 is a Web3 protocol that makes it easier for enterprises to enter the blockchain economy. It provides the infrastructure to launch on-chain loyalty programs, create new financial products, and tokenize cash flows—helping businesses stay both safe and flexible in their operations.
Solution Description:
- Businesses connect to the NEX3 reward system (sponsored by Web3 projects).

- Their users complete tasks → earn NEX3 Tokens or XP → redeem gifts or upgrade their membership level.

- NEX3 operates the platform, manages the reward pool, and provides the Web3 infrastructure.

- Businesses help distribute the experience to their own users.
How it works:
- The brand integrates a mini-app.
- Users complete quests.
- They receive rewards from an existing pool (no sponsorship required from the brand).
- The business earns commission from the reward pool.
New Web3 users are brought to the brand.
Delivered Value:
- Budget-Driven: Leverage available rewards from Web3 partners → no need for internal budget spending.

- New User: Attract new users from Web3 communities through quest campaigns and token rewards.

- Blockchain-Ready: Integrate Web3 experiences (wallets, tokens, NFTs, etc.) without needing your own infrastructure.

- Ecosystem Expansion: Connect with other Web3 partners in the NEX3 ecosystem → enable cross-promotion and shared communities.
The role of the business:
- Create user touchpoints (offline or in-app)

- Promote the campaign

- Receive revenue share from
reward distribution activities
